<b>Fine Pins</b> is a [[Hunt Wishes|Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, started from the Wishwall in [[Songclave]] once it becomes available.

== Wish ==
[[File:Fine Pin.png|link=Fine Pin|left|thumb|100x100px]]

The required 12 [[Fine Pin]]s can be found in the [[Choral Chambers]] by slaying [[Choristor]]s or [[Reed]]s and picking up the pins dropped from their corpses. These enemies are found mostly in the western hallways and the eastern vertical shaft of the Chambers.

The pin projectiles that Reeds throw at [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] cannot be picked up for this Wish.

== Reward ==
[[File:Heavy Rosary Necklace.png|link=Heavy Rosary Necklace|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After delivering 12 Fine Pins to the Wishwall in Songclave, Hornet is rewarded with a [[Heavy Rosary Necklace]] containing {{R|220}}. A rack of pins is added to the background of Songclave after completing the wish.
